entries.544aa7c56f5d31d7: The medium-term management plan "Building the Future 2030" (five years, from the fiscal year ended June 2026 to the fiscal year ending June 2030) sets building a business portfolio and strengthening earnings power as its basic policies, and it will work on maintaining and strengthening its global niche top position in the cardiovascular field, strengthening sales strategies and product portfolios aimed at global niche top positions in non-cardiovascular fields, and creating new businesses and entering high value-added therapeutic devices. As its revised target, it aims for consolidated net sales of ¥212.5 billion in the fiscal year ending June 2030. Its long-term vision sets "a global niche top company that can comprehensively solve clinical challenges in minimally invasive treatment" as its ideal state for 2035, and it aims to achieve consolidated net sales of ¥330 billion in the fiscal year ending June 2035.
